Overview

Volos is a city in Thessaly with a population of 144,449. Coastal Thessalian city at the foot of Mount Pelion, known for its waterfront, tsipouro, and seafood. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews older, with a median age of 46.0.
